Foods: Large variety of invertebrates and plant materials.
Miscella neous: Includes: Savannah, grasshopper, Baird's, sharp-tailed vesper, lark, tree, chipping, clay-colored, Brewer's, field, Harris's, white-crowned, white-throated, fox, Lincoln's, and song sparrows.
Name: Juncos - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Winter.
Habitat: Conifers and mixed forests. Nest on ground.
Foods: Caterpillars, beetles, ants (choice animal foods), other insects, spiders, ragweed, dropseed, pigweed, goosefoot, wheat, sedge.
Name: Longspurs - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in:
Habitat: Open areas; plains, praries, airports, fields. Nest on ground.
Foods: Insects, spiders, sunflower, wheat, goosefoot, grama, needlegrass, ragweed, sedge, dropseed, clover, bulrush, three-awn, pigweed.
Miscellaneous: Includes: McCown's, lapbud, Smith's and chestnutcollared longspurs.
Name: Snow Bunting - Family Fringillidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Migratory only.
Habitat: Praries, fields, shores. Nest on ground.
Foods: Mostly plant. Fly larvae, true bugs, sand fleas, ragweed, pigweed, goosefoot, sedge, buttercup, dropseed, wheat, fescue bulrush.
Source: Peterson 1961, Martin, Zim, and Nelson 1961.
